services:
  elasticsearch:
    image: elasticsearch:{{es_version}}
    environment:
      - discovery.type=single-node
      - xpack.security.enabled=false
      - ES_JAVA_OPTS=-Xms1g -Xmx1g
    ports: ["9200:9200"]
    volumes: ["esdata:/usr/share/elasticsearch/data"]

  kibana:
    image: kibana:{{es_version}}
    ports: ["5601:5601"]
    depends_on: [elasticsearch]

volumes:
  esdata:
